title: Label-Free Finite-Volume-Residual Training of Attention Graph Neural Networks for Coupled Thermo-Fluid Fields
abstract: arXiv:2607.20321v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Neural surrogates are widely used in scientific machine learning for fast prediction of three-dimensional (3D) thermo-fluid fields. However, generating training data using conventional numerical solvers often incurs substantial computational and storage costs. We propose to train an attention graph neural network by minimizing the finite-volume method (FVM) residuals of the governing equations. These residuals are evaluated directly on the mesh, requiring no labeled data. We evaluate the trained surrogates against computational fluid dynamics (CFD) references and a data-supervised baseline across four scenarios. On the two steady-state benchmarks, each solved on the same mesh as its CFD reference, the FVM-loss model reproduces the reference flow and temperature fields with mean field-averaged normalized root-mean-square errors (nRMSEs) near 3%, including the buoyancy-energy coupling. tldr: 该论文提出一种无标签训练方法，通过直接在网格上最小化有限体积法（FVM）残差来训练注意力图神经网络，无需CFD求解器生成标注数据，即可在耦合热流体场预测中达到约3%的nRMSE精度，显著降低了训练数据的计算与存储成本。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a label-free training approach for attention graph neural networks by minimizing finite-volume method (FVM) residuals directly on the mesh, eliminating the need for costly CFD-generated labeled data while achieving ~3% nRMSE accuracy in predicting coupled thermo-fluid fields.
